cohort: Singleton, pregnant women at 28 weeks of gestation or greater with a CD history between January 2017 and December 2017
finding: Compared to intrapartum CD, prior prelabor CD increased the risk of PPH in a subsequent pregnancy only when complicated by PP and PAS.
mod_finding: Compared to intrapartum cesarean delivery, prior prelabor cesarean delivery increased the risk of postpartum hemorrhage in a subsequent pregnancy only when complicated by placenta previa and placenta accreta spectrum.
